description: Berlin Mietspiegel editions — extracted from official PDFs

derivation.by_lage: mean of Mittelwerte in the NEWEST cohort across its non-empty size bands, excluding low-sample cells. Cohort boundary: 2003-2015 for 2017, 2003-2017 for 2019/2021/2023.
derivation.by_lage_same_cohort: mean of Mittelwerte in the 1991-2002 cohort (present in all editions) — the apples-to-apples time series.
